description:
Put your MCP server behind Privi. You get an HTTP URL and a WebSocket URL that forward to it unchanged (x402
payments keep working) while Privi rate-limits callers, optionally requires a Privi Passport, meters every tool call
and writes each call to your tamper-evident log. The kill switch stops the gateway instantly. Upstream must be public
HTTPS. Requires the organization API key.

guard.description: Privi Guard on every tool result: off, tag (add the verdict in _meta) or block (withhold injected results). Each check uses your Guard allowance or credits
guard.title: Guard

min_score.description: 0 = open to everyone. >0 = callers must prove a KYA wallet whose Passport scores at least this (0-1000)
min_score.title: Min Score

name.description: A name for this gateway, e.g. 'acme-search-mcp'
name.title: Name

upstream_url.description: The MCP server's public https URL (streamable HTTP), e.g. https://api.acme.com/mcp
upstream_url.title: Upstream Url

name: gateway_create
title: Gateway: protect and meter an MCP server
